SINAMICS Startdrive G110M, G120, G120C, G120D, G120P, G115D

Comment.MultiLanguageText: Caller-visible interface (C-115) - FC_ControlMain writes CycleStart/CycleStop/feedback/tunables in, reads Run*/EnableUpstream/PreStartSounder/motor-command bits out. See the block header for the Step value legend.

Stop-all: operator CycleStop, loss of DownstreamRunning (nowhere for shredded material to go), or loss of SystemHealthy (control circuit/E-stop - REQ-062: recovery must demand a fresh start press, so the sequence may not sit in a run step through an E-stop). Read by every step's own stop transition below and mirrored to the pusher as PusherCycleInhibitCmd.

Named once (C-601): the hard pusher force - operator stop or circuit-unhealthy, plus the overcurrent-abort step. Forces PusherModeCmd to 0, which parks the pusher AND blocks jogging. Deliberately NOT the full StopCmd (owner amendment 2026-07-16): downstream absence must leave hand-jog available (REQ-040), so it reaches the pusher only as PusherCycleInhibitCmd.

Reversals since the window last re-armed (not per-cycle, unlike the pusher's own PressureTripCount) - ReversalWindowTimer restarts the window every time this is above zero, so ReversalCountThreshold reversals must occur within one ReversalWindowTime of each other to raise ShredderBlockedFault, not just ReversalCountThreshold times ever.
Latched once InfeedRestartTimer has timed out from the last hopper-clear - drives RunInfeedConv directly and (after a further UpstreamEnableTimer delay) EnableUpstream.

KNOWN GAP, not wired to real current yet: both timers below are gated 'AND NOT AlwaysTrue' (permanently false placeholders) because DB_AnalogInput.ShredderMotorCurrent > DB_Settings.OvercurrentSetpointMedium/High is a genuine Real-vs-Real comparison this converter's synthesizer can't type correctly yet (hardcodes Int) - flagged and deferred rather than guessed at. This bit, and Step 50's own overcurrent-abort transition, are dead code until that's built.

AttributeList.Text: Shredder plant sequencer (C-118-C-125): commands the shredder motor (via FB_MotorFwdRevSystem, wired at FC_ControlMain) and gates infeed/discharge conveyors and upstream enable, through a stepped cycle. Step legend (C-120): 0=Idle (stopped, waiting for a start condition) - 10=PreStart (siren warning before motion; arms the motor via MotorStartArm) - 20=DischargeStart (discharge conveyor starting, timed) - 30=ReverseRun (reverse commanded; the motor FB's own ReverseDelay entry pause elapses inside this step, then ReverseRunTimer counts ShredderReverseRunTime of CONFIRMED reverse feedback) - 40=WaitForwardRun (waiting for forward-run feedback) - 50=Running (normal production; infeed/upstream-enable timers and overcurrent detection are live) - 60=OvercurrentAbort (tripped - pause, then retry into ReverseRun, or stay out if too many reversals). Stop-all (REQ-012/013/062): StopCmd = stop button OR downstream lost OR control circuit unhealthy - aborts every step to Idle. Pusher handling is split (owner amendment 2026-07-16): stop button/unhealthy force pusher mode 0 (parks AND blocks jog), while any live stop reason - downstream loss included - raises PusherCycleInhibitCmd (no cycle launches or continues into a stopped plant, hand-jog stays available).

HMI/DB_Settings times are Real seconds for operator legibility; every TON below needs its PT in DInt ms - one MUL+CONVERT pair per timer, matching the MotorDOL FTTime/EnableUPSTime idiom. Kept as one block up front rather than repeated at each timer, so the x1000 idiom is visibly consistent and only ever done once.

Retriggerable on-delay built from TON+edge (C-406/C-404 - no TONR/TOF exists to do this natively). IN drops false the instant a NEW reversal is detected - Step transitioning into 60, tested against ReversalStepEdgeMem's own previous-scan value (correct read-before-write ordering: this network reads the memory bit before Network 4 updates it later the same scan, so no cross-network staleness) - which resets ET/Q to 0 that scan; the timer then re-arms and must run a full ReversalWindowTime with no further reversal before Q goes true. Fixed 2026-07-17 (owner ruling, B-5/REQ-028): the prior rung read IN := ReversalCount > 0 alone, a level condition that only ever ran once from the first reversal - a fixed window, not the re-arming one this network's own title always claimed (C-608).

Edge-counts entries into Step 60 (C-404 - constructed edge, not the built-in -|P|-; ReversalStepEdgeMem also gates Network 3's own timer-reset detection, same edge shape, read one scan earlier there by construction). Resets on ReversalWindowTimer.Q - 180s ran clean with no new reversal, re-armed every time Network 3 sees a new edge, so ReversalCountThreshold reversals must each land within ReversalWindowTime of the previous one, not just occur ReversalCountThreshold times ever - or a fault reset.
Step 20 (DischargeStart) - Timer, Timeout Fault, And Transitions

ReverseRunTimer counts only while reverse is CONFIRMED running (ShredderRunRevFB), so the spec's 6 s (REQ-005) buys 6 s of actual rotation - the motor FB's 8 s ReverseDelay entry pause no longer eats the window, and a feedback dropout restarts the count. The commanded-but-no-feedback dwell is deliberately NOT re-timed here (C-409, one interval one place; step 40 already relies on the same mechanism): the motor FB's own fail-to-run window (FTTime, after its ReverseIgnoreFT masking) latches FTR, and the MotorFaultActive exit below aborts the step - bounded dwell, latched fault, C-122's substance without a duplicate timer.

UpstreamEnableTimer's own IN reads InfeedRunning one scan behind this network's own InfeedRunning update below (it's kind-ordered before the coil that writes it) - harmless for a multi-second delay, and matches this design's original timing exactly. EnableUpstream lives here, next to its own timer, rather than in the general Output Commands network - this is the output the MotorFwdRevSystem CALL-site correction was specifically about: it must only ever come from Step=50 dwell time, never from motor-running telemetry.
Step 50 (Running) - Infeed Restart, Upstream Enable, And Outputs

SpinUpTimer allows a brief inrush allowance before either overcurrent timer arms (both gated on SpinUpTimer.Q) - see OvercurrentTripped's own comment for the AlwaysTrue placeholder gap this still has.
Step 50 - Overcurrent Detection, Trip, And Transitions

MotorStartArm asserts only through PreStart: one operator start press = one motor arming (FC_ControlMain hands it to the motor FB's self-clearing RecentStart - REQ-062). PusherParkCmd holds through the machine-start steps 20-40 (range intent, C-603: any step inserted inside the start ramp still wants the pusher home) - long enough for the pusher's warned repark to fire even when the discharge confirm is quick (REQ-045); from Running onward the pusher's own cycle-entry repark takes over. Pusher stop handling is two-tier (REQ-012/013 + owner amendment 2026-07-16): PusherModeForceOff (stop button/unhealthy/step-60, mirroring the step-60 overcurrent force) drives mode 0 - parks the pusher and blocks jog - while PusherCycleInhibitCmd mirrors the full StopCmd so downstream loss still stops cycle behavior without taking hand-jog away (REQ-040).
